items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: He and Kid René were in the band? Yeah, they were both in there.

ctx.x: No, that was the Holmes band.
The Worthy. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. He and Kid René. He and Kid René were in the band? Yeah, they were both in there. Did your band play in the Labor Day Parade, too?
Yeah, my band was right in front of it. I heard a trumpet back there.
